overclaims: The GPT-4 preprint revised on April 13, 2023 reported capabilities across several domains and described the system as an early, incomplete form of AGI [e4].
checks.note: The axis, horizon and unresolved outcome match the reviews. The statement excerpt and proposition are faithful. Problem 1: the e4 rationale sentence drops the authors' hedge. They wrote that early GPT-4 'could reasonably be viewed as' an early, incomplete AGI; the rationale says they described it as one. Problem 2: the e4 excerpt 'human-level performance' cuts 'strikingly close to' from the source. Read alone, it suggests GPT-4 reached human-level performance. Other citations, dates and limitations check out.
